Questions

Which WageGrid metro has the highest Police officers annual median?

Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA has the highest published OEWS May 2025 annual median for Police and Sheriff's Patrol Officers ($115,120). Among metros with a published median: Seattle $115,120, Chicago $107,810, Austin $82,290. WageGrid does not rank suppressed cells or invent a missing wage.

Which WageGrid metro employs the most Police officers?

Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN has the highest published OEWS May 2025 employment for Police and Sheriff's Patrol Officers (22,680 wage-and-salary workers). Published employment: Chicago 22,680, Austin 4,540, Seattle 4,520. Self-employed workers are excluded.

Where are Police officers most concentrated relative to the national mix?

Chicago has the highest published location quotient (1.17). Published LQs: Chicago 1.17, Austin 0.81, Seattle 0.50.

What is the hourly median for Police officers in each metro?

OEWS May 2025 hourly medians: Austin $39.56; Chicago $51.83; Seattle $55.35. Blank means BLS withheld the estimate.

Does this comparison include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS covers wage-and-salary workers and excludes the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment estimate.

U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. WageGrid is not affiliated with BLS. Blank cells are BLS suppressions, not estimates.
